description:
AcmeCorp has rebranded to AcmeTech. Rename the virtual server domain from 'acmecorp.test' to 'acmetech.test' in Virtualmin.

The virtual server 'acmecorp.test' currently exists with web hosting (Apache), DNS (BIND), email (Postfix/Dovecot), and MySQL database features enabled. You need to:

1. Find the 'Change Domain Name' feature in Virtualmin for the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server (typically under Server Configuration > Change Domain Name)
2. Change the domain name to 'acmetech.test'
3. Make sure the home directory is renamed to match the new domain
4. Make sure the MySQL database name is updated to match the new domain
5. Execute the rename and confirm it completed successfully

After completion, 'acmetech.test' should appear in the domain list with all features (web, DNS, mail, MySQL) preserved, and 'acmecorp.test' should no longer exist.

Firefox is already open and logged into Virtualmin at https://localhost:10000 with the acmecorp.test domain selected.
